sections.title: Streaming Protocols
sections.description: Industry-standard protocols for delivering live and on-demand video over IP networks.

items.name: HLS (HTTP Live Streaming)
items.description: Apple's adaptive bitrate protocol that segments video into chunks delivered over HTTP. Widely supported across browsers, smart TVs, and mobile devices.

items.name: MPEG-DASH
items.description: An open, codec-agnostic adaptive streaming standard. Offers flexible bitrate adaptation and is well-suited for large-scale VOD and live delivery.

items.name: RTSP / RTP
items.description: Low-latency protocols used for IP camera feeds and legacy IPTV systems. RTSP handles session control while RTP carries the media payload.

sections.title: Video Encoding & Transcoding
sections.description: Codecs and tools that compress, convert, and optimize video for efficient streaming delivery.

items.name: H.264 (AVC)
items.description: The most widely deployed video codec. Delivers strong compression with broad hardware and software decoding support across all platforms.

items.name: H.265 (HEVC)
items.description: Successor to H.264 offering up to 50% better compression at equivalent quality. Ideal for 4K and bandwidth-constrained delivery.

items.name: FFmpeg
items.description: Open-source multimedia framework for transcoding, muxing, filtering, and streaming. The de facto tool for server-side video processing pipelines.

items.name: Hardware Encoders
items.description: GPU-accelerated encoding via NVIDIA NVENC, AMD VCE, or Intel Quick Sync. Significantly reduces CPU load for high-throughput live transcoding.

sections.title: Media Servers
sections.description: Platforms that ingest, process, and distribute video streams to end users at scale.

items.name: Wowza Streaming Engine
items.description: Enterprise-grade media server supporting RTMP, HLS, DASH, and WebRTC ingest and playback. Suitable for large-scale live and VOD deployments.

items.name: Xtream UI
items.description: A full IPTV panel providing stream management, user authentication, EPG integration, and a built-in API for reseller and end-user access control.

items.name: Nginx with RTMP Module
items.description: Lightweight, high-performance solution combining Nginx's HTTP serving with the nginx-rtmp-module for live RTMP ingest and HLS/DASH output.

sections.title: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
sections.description: Global edge networks that cache and deliver video content with low latency and high availability.

items.name: Cloudflare
items.description: Edge CDN with built-in DDoS protection, stream caching, and Cloudflare Stream for video hosting. Strong free-tier offering with global PoP coverage.

items.name: Akamai Technologies
items.description: Enterprise CDN with one of the largest edge networks. Offers advanced stream optimization, token authentication, and SLA-backed delivery.

items.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
items.description: CloudFront CDN paired with MediaLive and MediaPackage for end-to-end live and VOD stream packaging, encryption, and global distribution.

sections.title: Player Applications
sections.description: Client-side applications and interfaces that decode and render IPTV streams for viewers.

items.name: VLC
items.description: Open-source, cross-platform media player supporting virtually all stream formats and protocols. Widely used for testing and end-user IPTV playback.

items.name: IPTV Smarters
items.description: Feature-rich IPTV client for Android, iOS, and smart TVs. Supports M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API, EPG, and multi-screen layouts.

items.name: Smart TV Apps
items.description: Native applications for Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, and Android TV. Provide optimized playback experiences with remote control and EPG support.

items.name: HTML5 Web Players
items.description: Browser-based players such as Video.js, HLS.js, and Shaka Player. Enable in-browser HLS/DASH playback without plugins via the Media Source Extensions API.
